plan.title: PTBot Sweep Runner
plan.summary: Add a ptbot-sweep CLI command that reads a TOML config of (sector, geography) market targets, slices a configurable year range into annual windows, skips combinations already persisted in the SQLite DB, and runs the pipeline sequentially to build up the database automatically.
deliverables: query_run_exists() added to src/ptbot/db.py — json_extract-based skip detection
New module src/ptbot/sweep.py — SweepConfig models, generate_annual_windows(), slug(), run_sweep()
New module src/ptbot/sweep_cli.py — ptbot-sweep entry point with --config, --db-path, --dry-run
pyproject.toml updated with ptbot-sweep script entry point
sweep.example.toml at project root with annotated example config
New tests/test_sweep.py covering windows, config parsing, skip logic, dry-run
Passes task check (format, lint, type-check, tests, coverage, build)
constraints: No new runtime dependencies — use tomllib (stdlib Python 3.11+)
Existing ptbot CLI and all existing tests unchanged
Frozen pydantic models in models.py — do not modify
